# /crav1-review-plan

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a spec to a plan](../../from-spec-to-plan.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-review-plan/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Start the crav1-plan-reviewer-agent subagent on plan.md and tasks.md against spec.md.

Critique `plan.md` / `tasks.md` against the spec; numbered `P#`s.

## Runs when

Plan exists; want a critique. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: Spec, plan, tasks.

Reads `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md`.

## Writes

In short: Nothing (numbered `P#`s in chat).

Writes nothing.

## Does not

Leaves the plan and code alone.

Limits and exceptions: the parent delegates the critique and does not review in its own voice. It names [`/crav1-tighten-plan`](crav1-tighten-plan.md) and does not run it. A piece marked already there or left as committed is not a missing task.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-tighten-plan`](crav1-tighten-plan.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.
